svg.title: The text index: trigrams narrow the files, Engine A confirms
svg.desc: When indexing, each file's byte trigrams and mask bytes go into immutable segments. When searching, the pattern becomes a trigram condition, the postings give candidate files, and Engine A's per-file searcher reads only those.
svg.text: // THE TEXT INDEX: TRIGRAMS NARROW THE FILES, ENGINE A CONFIRMS

g.text: Engine A's own per-file searcher reads the candidate files from
the source tree, with the same translated pattern.
Results equal Engine A's on the indexed snapshot.
